snippet.title: Bloki - SEGA Master System Homebrew
snippet.description:
As part of a SMS Power Coding Cometition in 2015, this is a simple Tetris clone for the Master System developed by tripledonkey and sherpa. It finished 4th in the said competition.

Download link: https://www.smspower.org/Homebrew/Bloki-SMS
